task: Bring editable screens closer to original concept art

assets.name: logo
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Extract ONLY the CAR STARS logo from this reference as a standalone production logo asset on actual transparent background. Preserve the exact two-line stacked wording CAR above STARS, all original chunky rounded 3D block letter shapes, slightly playful curved baseline, thick joined dark navy silhouette backing, subtle royal-blue outer rim, white CAR faces with pale icy-blue bevels, saturated yellow STARS faces with orange-gold extrusion, glossy edge highlights, perspective and depth. This should closely match the actual reference logo, NOT a flat typeset imitation. Clean antialiased edges, centered with small transparent padding, no other words or icons, no city, no UI, no cast shadow extending far outside the logo. High resolution cutout.

Keep the exact rounded pill/rounded rectangle shape, broad face, softly curved corners, dimensional orange-gold lower thickness, buttery yellow gradient top, lemon-yellow upper rim, thin warm cream highlight inset border, small glossy bevels. Front-facing flat UI view, original style, broad horizontal face approximately 4.4:1, one button only, transparent padding, no city or UI, no lettering or symbols, no checkerboard baked into pixels. Rich warm saturated gold; avoid excessive chrome or casino ornaments.

assets.name: menu-thief
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Prepare the reference as a clean full portrait MAIN MENU BACKGROUND PLATE. Remove every logo, lettering, cream label capsule, selected badge, main role title, subtitle, settings icon/button and PLAY button, seamlessly reconstructing the city and road beneath them. Keep the exact 70/30 diagonal split and thin cream diagonal separator. Left dominant scene has ONE huge golden yellow getaway car drifting at screen center-left around 50% to 57% vertical height, original sweeping black tire tracks and white smoke, warm yellow/cream low-poly buildings with vivid blue roofs and green faceted trees. Right narrow side is a higher isometric city scene with multiple police vehicles and bright cyan dotted patrol routes/pins. Preserve sunny lighting, original saturated warm/cool contrast and soft miniature blur near outer edges. This is art only; no written words, no UI labels, no buttons, no logos. Portrait1:2.
